#.label: Voyado connector
#.description: Connection to Voyado through the Voyado connector. Used when loyalty routing is set to Voyado.
#/oneOf/0.title: Voyado API
#/oneOf/0.description: Loyalty requests are sent to the Voyado API with an API key.
#/oneOf/1.title: Not configured
#/oneOf/1.description: No Voyado connection is set for this target.
#/properties/baseUrl.label: Base URL
#/properties/baseUrl.description: Address of your Voyado API, for example https://yourcompany.voyado.com/api.
#/properties/timeout.label: Timeout (ms)
#/properties/timeout.description: How long to wait for Voyado to answer, in milliseconds.
#/properties/enabledBalancePoints.label: Show balance points
#/properties/enabledBalancePoints.descri: Fetch the member's points balance from Voyado.
#/properties/authenticationConfig.label: Authentication
#/properties/authenticationConfig/proper: API key created in Voyado for this integration.
